subject: agents
detail: useAgentChat now coalesces updates every 50ms; pass throttle: false to render every chunk as it arrives, or a number to change the interval.

source.quote:
`useAgentChat` now coalesces those updates every 50ms, which removes about 78%
  of renders on a fast stream and matches the value the AI SDK documents. The
  first chunk of a stream is never delayed. Pass `throttle: false` to render
  every chunk as it arrives, or a number to change the interval.
